pt-BR.name: Locadora
pt-BR.description: Um emulador de NES e Game Boy. Cada pessoa abre o seu jogo no seu computador. O pqp não fornece jogo nenhum.

en.name: Locadora
en.description: An NES and Game Boy emulator. Everyone opens their own game on their own computer. pqp does not provide any game.
en.notice: This is only an emulator. pqp does not provide games: only open one you have the right to play. The file stays on your computer and is never sent.
